task:
FIX TWO CONFIRMED REVIEW FINDINGS on PR #789 (Review Lab Phase 2 step 2). Target branch codex/run-37834232716-1, expected head abd21c90565c4cb0397abc9367f8c5fdfd5b4bad; fail closed if it moved. Only scripts/dev/seed_v3_fixture_generation.py and tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py may change. Do not change the Cypress wrapper's values or seed_review_v3_generation.py.

FINDING 1 (preflight bounds). In seed_v3_fixture_generation, BEFORE any connection access, also reject: (a) a generation_key_prefix whose length plus 16 exceeds 63, because the final key is prefix + uuid4().hex[:16] and v3_meta.derived_generation.generation_key has CHECK(generation_key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$') (sql/v3/migrations/003_ratings_v4_derived.sql:11), so the maximum prefix length is 47; express this with named constants, not a bare 47; (b) publication_actor or publication_note that are empty after str.strip(), because v3_meta.publish_derived_generation raises when length(trim(actor_))=0 (sql/v3/migrations/003_ratings_v4_derived.sql around line 220; verify the exact check you cite). Raise ValueError with a message naming the argument (never including connection details).

FINDING 2 (idempotent return must prove ownership). Today, if any derived generation is already published, the helper returns its sequence without checking it came from the requested fixture. Change the early-return path so it only returns the existing sequence when the CURRENT published derived generation is provably owned by this request, otherwise raise RuntimeError and change nothing:
 - read the current derived generation's generation_key and canonical_generation_id (v3_meta.current_derived_generation JOIN v3_meta.derived_generation USING (derived_generation_id) WHERE singleton);
 - require generation_key == generation_key_prefix + exactly 16 lowercase hex characters;
 - load the fixture with load_source_fixture(fixture_dir) and require the set of system id64s in that canonical generation's systems relation (resolve its schema from v3_meta.canonical_generation.relation_schema for that canonical_generation_id; validate the schema name against the same ^v3_gen_[a-z0-9_]+$-style pattern the API uses in apps/api/src/edfinder_api/v3_schema.py and compose the query with psycopg.sql.Identifier, never string formatting) to equal the fixture's system id64 set exactly.
 Keep migration probe-then-apply BEFORE this check exactly as today. Keep all other behaviour byte-for-byte unchanged, including the first-publish path.

TESTS (add only; do not edit or remove existing tests) in tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py:
 - non-DB: prefix of length 47 accepted by preflight and 48 rejected before connection access; whitespace-only actor and note rejected before connection access.
 - PostgreSQL (same skip guard and disposable-database pattern as the existing DB test): publish the Cypress fixture once; then (i) calling the Cypress wrapper again returns 1; (ii) calling seed_v3_fixture_generation on the same DB with fixture_dir = tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources and prefix 'review_lab_v3_' raises RuntimeError (different prefix); (iii) calling it with the Cypress prefix 'cypress_v3_' but fixture_dir = tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources raises RuntimeError (different system set); and after (ii) and (iii) there is still exactly one derived generation and the publication sequence is still 1.

VALIDATE and report: py_compile; ruff on both files; python -m pytest tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py tests/test_review_lab_v3.py tests/test_cypress_v3_fixture.py -q -rs. If you cannot run PostgreSQL, say the DB cases skipped; the reviewer will run them on PostgreSQL 18. git diff --name-only showing only the two allowed paths.
